sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球供应链制造母港、跨境电商货源地与外资合规准入市场

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Assembly of Bionic Companion Robotic Animals with Speech Synthesizers

stage_1.expense_line_item: Company name and business scope pre-verification (公司名稱及所營事業預查)
stage_1.charging_authority: MOEA (Bureau of Commerce, Company Registration Section)
stage_1.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff of NT$300 per application under the Company Registration Fee Schedule

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act, including Articles 2, 6, 128, 129, 131, 156, 387 and 388, as applicable to a company limited by shares. A Taiwan entity is not a PRC wholly foreign-owned enterprise (WFOE); the supplied jurisdiction code TW governs this dossier.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Department of Commerce, or the competent local government company-registration authority under delegated authority.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Company Registration (公司登記申請書), with the applicable articles of incorporation and incorporation documents.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Taiwan generally has no statutory minimum paid-in capital for an ordinary company limited by shares, subject to sufficient capital for the proposed business and any sector-specific rule. Capital must be subscribed and paid as required by the Company Act; a CPA must audit and certify the capital contribution before company registration. There is no general statutory escrow requirement. Foreign investment approval is generally required before foreign capital is remitted and invested, subject to applicable exceptions.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company accepts the subscriptions for the shares set out in the approved subscription schedule and authorizes issuance upon confirmation of payment and completion of applicable capital verification. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office shall be at [full Taiwan address], subject to confirmation of lawful occupancy and permitted use. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [name] is appointed Chairperson, [name] is appointed General Manager, and [name] is appointed responsible person for registration and filings, each to serve subject to the Company Act and the Articles of Incorporation. Any director is authorized to execute and file the documents necessary to implement these resolutions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirm foreign-investment eligibility and obtain approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Investment Review Department (IRD); applications are submitted through the applicable foreign-investment application channel.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm that the proposed investors and activities are permitted under Taiwan’s foreign-investment rules and the current negative list. Apply for foreign-investment approval before remitting investment funds where required. Provide certified or notarized investor documents as required for the investor’s jurisdiction; complete authentication or legalization and Chinese translation where required. Do not describe the proposed entity as a PRC WFOE.
required_dossiers: Proposed articles of incorporation and capital structure
Power of attorney and required authentication, legalization, and Chinese translations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to IRD requests within the stated deadline with corrected forms, supporting ownership records, translations, or revised activity descriptions. Seek written clarification before remitting funds if approval scope is uncertain.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reserve the company name and business scope
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Department of Commerce online company-name and business-scope pre-review service, or the competent local government registration counter.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit proposed Chinese company names in ranked order and the appropriate business codes and descriptions. Use accurate descriptions for robotic toy assembly, electronics, software, and sales; do not claim a statutory license exemption as a substitute for confirming facility and product rules.
required_dossiers: Applicant identification or power of attorney
Proposed business activities and corresponding business codes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Submit alternative names or revise the business scope to address similarity, restricted wording, or classification objections.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establish the registered office and prepare incorporation documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company promoters and the competent MOEA or delegated local-government company-registration authority.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt articles of incorporation, determine share subscriptions, appoint the initial directors and statutory auditor where applicable, and document the registered office. Confirm that the address may lawfully be used for the proposed activities. Execute documents in the form required for each signatory; obtain notarization, authentication, legalization, and Chinese translations where required for foreign-executed documents.
required_dossiers: Promoters’ and initial directors’ consents and identity records
Share subscription schedule and capital-contribution records
Registered-office consent, lease, or occupancy evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct execution defects, replace an ineligible address, and re-execute or authenticate documents in the form specified by the registration authority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pay capital and complete CPA capital verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan financial institution holding the company formation account and a Taiwan-licensed certified public accountant.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the required formation account, remit approved foreign investment through compliant banking channels where applicable, and retain bank evidence. Have a Taiwan-licensed CPA audit and certify the capital contribution before filing for company registration. The account is not a general statutory escrow account.
required_dossiers: Foreign-investment approval and remittance documents, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Reconcile discrepancies between subscribed capital, remittances, and bank statements; provide supplementary evidence or correct the capital records and obtain an amended CPA report.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Department of Commerce online company registration system or the competent local-government company-registration counter.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Company Registration Application (公司登記申請書) with the articles, director and shareholder information, registered-office evidence, CPA capital verification, and foreign-investment approval where applicable. Pay the registration fee, which is calculated under the applicable fee rules and may vary with capital and filing method; USD 25 above is an indicative conversion, not a fixed statutory USD charge.
required_dossiers: Articles of incorporation and incorporation records
Director, statutory auditor, and shareholder information
Foreign-investment approval and authenticated foreign documents, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Answer the authority’s written query within its deadline, correct the application or supporting documents, pay any fee shortfall, and resubmit. Request administrative clarification or pursue available administrative remedies if registration is refused.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete tax, business, and operational registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan Ministry of Finance, National Taxation Bureau with jurisdiction over the registered office; relevant local authorities for premises and factory matters.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After company registration, complete tax registration before commencing taxable business, establish required accounting and invoice controls, and determine whether factory registration, building-use, zoning, or other premises approvals apply. Register or obtain product approvals separately where the products fall within regulated categories.
required_dossiers: Company registration certificate and approved registration particulars
Tax registration application and responsible-person identification
Factory and product-regulatory applications, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct tax or premises records and obtain required approvals before commencing the affected activity; suspend any activity requiring an outstanding permit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: MOEA Department of Commerce or competent local-government company-registration authority for company matters; the competent local-government economic development or industrial authority for factory registration. The described assembly activity does not, on the supplied facts alone, establish a separate sectoral manufacturing license.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No general industrial operating license is identified solely for assembly of interactive robotic toy hardware. Factory Registration (工廠登記) may be required if the premises and activity meet statutory thresholds; confirm applicability with the competent local authority before production.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment, Taiwan, and the competent local environmental protection bureau
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Project-specific screening. No EIA tier can be assigned without the site, scale, process, and applicable EIA screening criteria; ordinary small-scale assembly is not automatically subject to a full EIA.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Obtain any required wastewater discharge permit and comply with applicable Water Pollution Control Act standards and permit limits. Obtain air-pollution permits if regulated stationary sources or processes are present and comply with applicable emissions limits. Manage industrial waste through authorized handling channels under the Waste Disposal Act. No numeric threshold can be determined from the supplied activity description alone.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Before occupancy and production, confirm lawful zoning and building use, required fire-safety equipment and inspection, and any building or structural approvals applicable to the premises and equipment loads. Comply with the Occupational Safety and Health Act, workplace risk-control and reporting requirements, and any inspections required for the actual facility. Exact clearances depend on site, building classification, workforce, and production processes.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Taiwan (target jurisdiction): Ministry of Finance (財政部, MOF), administered by the five Regional National Taxation Bureaus (國稅局); unified e-tax portal: https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw. China (entity home jurisdiction): State Taxation Administration (國家稅務總局, STA); Electronic Tax Bureau portal: https://etax.chinatax.gov.cn.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: China WFOE home registration: (1) obtain a Unified Social Credit Code (統一社會信用代碼) on the SAMR business license, which is the statutory tax ID for all invoicing and tax filing; (2) complete tax registration with the local STA office within 30 days of license issuance, submitting taxpayer status, accounting basis, legal representative, and bank account particulars; (3) apply for VAT general taxpayer status when annual taxable sales reach RMB 5 million (compulsory threshold) or voluntarily below it. Taiwan market-side registration: (1) for pure physical goods export into Taiwan with no Taiwan fixed place of business, the WFOE is not required to obtain a Taiwanese tax identification number; Taiwan Business Tax on imported robotic pet toys is collected by Taiwan Customs from the Taiwan importer/purchaser; (2) if a Taiwan branch is established, apply for branch registration with the Ministry of Economic Affairs, then register for profit-seeking enterprise income tax and business tax with the local National Taxation Bureau to obtain a Unified Business Number (統一編號); (3) if the WFOE directly supplies cross-border electronic/offshore services to Taiwanese individuals, it must complete online business tax registration once annual turnover exceeds NT$480,000.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: the China WFOE is a PRC resident enterprise taxed on worldwide income at 25% (15% if certified as a High/New Technology Enterprise); no pass-through election exists for limited liability entities. Taiwan: a Taiwan branch or PE of the WFOE is taxed at the entity level at 20% profit-seeking enterprise income tax on Taiwan-source income only; Territorial_Scope applies because non-Taiwan-source manufacturing profits are excluded absent a Taiwan PE. Tax_Exempt_Zone status is not available for this ISIC 3240 manufacturing/export business in either jurisdiction.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: China: no check-the-box election; available elections include (1) VAT general taxpayer vs. small-scale taxpayer status below the RMB 5 million annual turnover threshold, (2) special reorganization tax treatment under Caishui [2009] No. 59, and (3) the standard export 'exemption, credit, and refund' (免抵退) election arising from general taxpayer status. Taiwan: no check-the-box election; available elections include (1) Advance Pricing Agreements for related-party cross-border transactions, (2) CFC/PEM exemption declarations under the Income Tax Act Articles 43-3 and 43-4 for bona fide offshore business structures, and (3) election of branch vs. subsidiary legal form at MOEA registration. Both jurisdictions apply OECD-aligned hybrid mismatch and general anti-avoidance rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Taiwan: Value-Added Business Tax (加值型營業稅, VAT-type consumption tax) imposed at importation and on domestic B2B/B2C supplies. China: Value-Added Tax (增值稅) on domestic sales of goods and services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Taiwan: NT$480,000 annual taxable sales of cross-border electronic services by non-resident sellers, NT$80,000 per month for goods / NT$40,000 per month for services for domestic small-scale enterprises, no registration threshold for physical imports which are taxed at customs. China: RMB 5,000,000 annual turnover is the compulsory VAT general taxpayer registration threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Taiwan: mandatory e-invoice (電子發票) regime for all VAT general taxpayers; e-invoice data must be transmitted via MOF-certified Turnkey Service Centers (加值服務中心) to the Integrated E-Invoice Platform (電子發票整合服務平台) on a continuous basis, with a consolidated VAT return filed every two months; B2B API/GUI machine-readable submission is mandatory. China: fully digitalized electronic invoices (數電票/全面數字化電子發票) are mandatory; invoices are issued through the STA E-Invoice Platform with near-real-time data upload, automatic red-invoice control, and mandatory invoice verification for input VAT credit claims.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The AI bionic pet robot is manufactured in mainland China and exported to Taiwan; China's VAT export zero-rating applies under the 'exemption, credit, and refund' (免抵退) mechanism provided the WFOE is a VAT general taxpayer, the goods are physically shipped out of PRC customs territory, and a valid export customs declaration is filed. The applicable export rebate rate for HS 9503 toy/robotic products is the full 13% statutory VAT rate. Taiwan Business Tax is not zero-rated on this particular cross-strait flow because the taxable import event occurs in Taiwan: Taiwan Customs assesses a 5% business tax on the imported AI pet robot at importation. Subsequent re-export from Taiwan would qualify for zero-rating under Article 7 of the Business Tax Act.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: PRC Customs Export Declaration (出口貨物報關單) matching HS code 9503 (robotic toy animals / ISIC 3240)
VAT special invoice or qualifying export invoice issued by the WFOE reflecting the export sale
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical shipment to a Taiwan port
Bank inward remittance certificate / SAFE foreign exchange settlement record proving collection from the Taiwan buyer
Export sales contract, commercial invoice, and packing list
Taiwan import clearance record (進口報單) and proof of Taiwan customs duty and business tax payment (完稅證明)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: China: fraudulent export VAT refund claims are criminalized under Article 204 of the Criminal Law, with imprisonment of 5-10 years (extendable to life in severe cases) and fines of 1-5 times the refund defrauded; administrative clawback under the Export Tax Refund Administration Measures requires repayment of the refund plus interest surcharge, with a 5-year assessment limitation period (10 years for fraud); STA and the General Administration of Customs jointly monitor abnormal export pricing, HS code misclassification, and round-tripping of identical goods. Taiwan: any fraudulent zero-rating claim, import duty misdeclaration, or fabrication of export documentation exposes the taxpayer to a 1-10x underpaid business tax penalty under Article 51 of the Business Tax Act, criminal liability under Article 41 (imprisonment up to 5 years), and a 5-year retroactive audit window (7 years in fraud cases). The 180-day foreign exchange repatriation deadline for export proceeds is enforced under SAFE rules for the Chinese exporter; late collection must be documented with bank corroboration to avoid exchange-control and export refund clawback reviews.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements and Business Report filed with MOEA pursuant to Company Act Article 20
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Department of Commerce, via MOEA Company Registration and Management System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year company, on or before 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file may trigger MOEA rectification orders, administrative fines ranging from NT$10,000 to NT$100,000 per violation, and, upon continued non-compliance, compulsory dissolution or strike-off of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Shareholder Meeting approving the Business Report, Financial Statements, and Earnings Distribution Proposal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company shareholders; meeting minutes retained in the statutory Minute Book and not separately filed unless a registration change is required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be convened within 6 months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year company, no later than 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Directors who fail to convene the meeting may be fined under Company Act Article 171; repeated failure may expose the company to MOEA administrative dissolution action.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Return including Unappropriated Earnings Tax declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance (district tax bureau for the company's registered office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year taxpayers, from 1 May to 31 May of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing may incur surcharges (up to 10% of tax payable) under the Income Tax Act and a minimum penalty of NT$1,500; late payment interest is charged on any unpaid balance, and prolonged non-filing may result in tax assessment, liens, or enforced collection.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Maintenance of Company Registration Status and Statutory Records
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MOEA and the company's registered office; inspection and confirmation on request or upon any registered matter change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous; statutory registers must be corrected within a reasonable time after each share transfer, with formal registration changes filed within 15 days for matters required by the Articles or Company Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Neglect of statutory registers may lead to fines against responsible persons under Company Act; incorrect or missing records may obstruct future filings and expose the company to penalties and judicial dissolution.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent CPA audit is required for public/listed companies, banks, insurance enterprises, and any non-public company whose paid-in capital exceeds NT$50 million or as otherwise designated by the competent authority. A small private WFOE below the NT$50 million threshold is not subject to a compulsory statutory audit unless required by its Articles, shareholders, or financing/lending covenants.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Public companies: Taiwan-IFRS (adopted IFRS). Non-public enterprises: Business Entity Accounting Standards (Taiwan GAAP) together with Company Act Chapter 5 requirements and relevant MOF/FSC guidance for regulated industries.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Taiwan does not impose a stand-alone annual UBO confirmation filing for private companies. The company must continuously maintain an updated Register of Members at its registered office and record every share transfer promptly. If a transfer or corporate action alters directors, capital, or registered matters prescribed by the Articles, a registration amendment must be filed with MOEA within 15 days. Under AML rules, beneficial ownership information must be maintained internally and produced to competent authorities upon request; no mandatory annual UBO declaration is required.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 400–1,500 USD per year for registered office and company secretarial/agent services in Taiwan
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 1,800–5,000 USD per year for a small unlisted Taiwan limited company with basic accounting records

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 15% reduced rate for High and New Technology Enterprise; small low-profit enterprise effective 5% on first RMB 3 million taxable income; 100% additional deduction for qualifying R&D expenses (total 200% deduction); one-off accelerated depreciation for eligible equipment; statutory surplus reserve (10% of distributable profit) required before shareholder distribution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Quarterly CIT Prepayment Return: 中华人民共和国企业所得税月（季）度预缴纳税申报表（A类，A200000）; filed electronically via the national Electronic Tax Bureau portal (电子税务局).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 15 days after the end of each calendar quarter (April 15, July 15, October 15, January 15); Q4 prepayment may be integrated with annual final settlement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cumulative net operating revenue for the current year-to-date period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: WFOE reports only its own revenue on accrual basis; Taiwan parent does not file this return and must not be included as a taxpayer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cumulative direct operating costs, including component procurement, assembly labor and manufacturing overhead.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany purchases from Taiwan related party must be booked at arm's length for the related-party disclosure later in the annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cumulative accounting profit per PRC GAAP before income tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must tie to the statutory financial statements that substantiate the WFOE's distributable profit for future dividends.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Profit basis used for quarterly prepayment after statutory adjustments (e.g., add-back of non-deductible items, reduction of tax-exempt income).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Under-payment caused by under-stating this line creates interest and penalties that reduce the WFOE's distributable earning capacity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly prepayment tax amount computed by applying 25% (or applicable preferential rate) to the actual profit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Taiwan shareholder should ensure accurate prepayments so that final dividend distribution is not delayed by tax arrears.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: RMB 2,000–10,000 (RMB 10,000–50,000 for serious cases); late payment surcharge 0.05% per day; fraudulent underpayment: penalty of 50%–500% of the underpaid tax under Law on the Administration of Tax Collection, Articles 62–64.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual CIT Final Settlement Return: 中华人民共和国企业所得税年度纳税申报表（A类，A100000) with supporting schedules; filed through the national Electronic Tax Bureau (电子税务局).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (fiscal year is the calendar year unless a special 12-month fiscal year is approved).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before May 31 following the fiscal year-end (December 31).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net revenue from sales of interactive AI pet robots, spare parts, and after-sales services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This figure determines the WFOE's gross margin; a non-arm's-length margin versus the Taiwan parent triggers transfer pricing scrutiny.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales: raw materials, modules, assembly labor, depreciation, and manufacturing overhead.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Component purchases from Taiwan related parties must be supported by contemporaneous pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Pre-tax accounting profit per PRC GAAP; includes non-operating income and expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Taiwan parent's audited consolidated statement must reconcile with the WFOE's local statutory profit to avoid deemed dividend adjustments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add-back of non-deductible expenses such as penalties, excess entertainment expense, unrelated supervisory fees, and thin-capitalization interest disallowance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Royalties paid to the Taiwan IP holder must pass the royalty deduction test (connection to actual use, no bundled services, arm's-length rate); excess payments are recharacterized as deemed dividends.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: A100000 Line 15–16 (纳税调整减少额 / 免税、减计收入及加计扣除)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reduction items: tax-exempt income, R&D additional deduction (100%), accelerated depreciation, and carryover of prior-year losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: R&D additional deduction must be evidenced by the WFOE's own qualified R&D personnel and projects; purely executing Taiwan-designed specifications for assembly may not qualify.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: A100000 Line 18 (弥补以前年度亏损)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Loss carryforward offset against current-year taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: General limit: 5 years; 10-year carryforward applies only to qualifying high-technology enterprise and technology-based SME losses (2018–2025 tax years).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final taxable income after all adjustments and loss mitigation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This figure is the denominator for effective tax rate reconciliation and the base for transfer pricing profit-level indicators.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computed at 25% (or 15% for High and New Technology Enterprise) on the adjusted taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The tax rate applied affects the distributable surplus available for the Taiwan shareholder.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: A100000 Line 29 (实际应纳所得税额)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable after foreign tax credits and treaty relief offsets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Domestic tax credits should not be conflated with the Cross-Strait Agreement dividend reduction, which is applied at the withholding stage.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Settlement balance: annual tax liability minus quarterly prepayments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A persistent refund position with a profitable Taiwan parent may trigger tax audit and transfer-pricing risk.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: RMB 2,000–10,000 (serious: RMB 10,000–50,000); daily late-payment surcharge 0.05% of overdue tax; penalty for under-declared tax: 50%–500%; criminal liability for false filing under Criminal Law Article 201 (tax evasion: imprisonment up to 3 years, or 3–7 years for huge amounts exceeding 30% of taxable income plus fines).

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% withholding income tax on dividends paid by the WFOE to non-resident enterprises under Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 3 and Article 37; no VAT is imposed on dividends; distribution must be made from after-tax profit after appropriating statutory surplus reserve (10% until reaching 50% of registered capital) and any agreed enterprise development funds.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Taiwan is governed by the Cross-Strait Agreement on Avoidance of Double Taxation and Strengthening Tax Cooperation (entered into force May 1, 2015), not by an ordinary OECD treaty. To obtain the 5% reduced rate on dividends: (i) the Taiwan beneficial owner must obtain a Taiwan Tax Resident Certificate (居住者證明) from the Taiwan National Taxation Bureau; (ii) the WFOE must submit the certificate together with the withholding return and a beneficial-ownership self-assessment to the PRC competent tax authority; (iii) the Taiwan company must prove substantive business operations, personnel and decision-making in Taiwan and pass the Beneficial Owner test under SAT Announcement 2018 No. 9; (iv) if the certificate is unavailable at payment date, 10% is withheld and the Taiwan shareholder may apply for refund under the Agreement's mutual agreement procedure within three years of the over-withholding.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and technical fees: statutory CIT WHT 10% plus VAT at 6% (with local surcharges); Cross-Strait Agreement ceiling on CIT WHT is 7%. Interest: statutory WHT 10%; Cross-Strait Agreement ceiling is 7%; interest paid to related-party lenders is further restricted by thin-capitalization rules (debt-to-equity ratio 2:1 for non-financial enterprises) and the arm's-length interest rate requirement.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File (本地文档): annual related-party tangible-asset transactions exceeding RMB 200 million; related-party intangible-asset transactions exceeding RMB 100 million; related-party financial-asset transactions exceeding RMB 100 million; other related-party transactions exceeding RMB 40 million. Mandatory Master File (主体文档): total annual related-party transactions exceeding RMB 1 billion. Any related-party transaction triggers the annual related-party disclosure schedules (A102000 series) filed with the annual CIT return. Local File must be prepared by the documentation deadline and submitted to the tax authority within 20 days of a statutory notice.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The PRC does not apply British-style Economic Substance Regulations; however, substance requirements are enforced through (i) the Beneficial Owner test in SAT Announcement 2018 No. 9 requiring substantive business activities, personnel, assets, and risk control in Taiwan; (ii) the General Anti-Avoidance Rule (GAAR) in EIT Law Article 47 and implementing rules; (iii) the substance-over-form doctrine allowing disregard or recharacterization of entities and transactions lacking bona fide business purpose; (iv) special tax adjustment rules on thin capitalization, related-party debt, and excessive royalty payments. A Taiwan intermediate holding company without real operations or with profits largely entitled to reduced taxation will be denied the 5% dividend rate and subjected to deemed dividend and transfer-pricing adjustments.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate under-reporting of WFOE revenue, fabrication of assembly costs, invoice-less sales of AI pet robots through e-commerce, or transfer of profits to Taiwan without corresponding services.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax collection with daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05%; penalty of 50%–500% of the unpaid tax (Tax Collection Administration Law Articles 40, 63); criminal prosecution under Criminal Law Article 201: imprisonment up to 7 years plus fines of 1–5 times the evaded tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative, financial officer directly responsible, and actual controllers face criminal prosecution; PRC courts and tax authorities may impose travel bans and exit restrictions under Tax Collection Administration Law Article 44 until tax liabilities are settled; civil restitution is recoverable from directors who participated in fraud or dissipated company assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: WFOE operating without real manufacturing premises or employees while profits are diverted to a Taiwan entity with no substantive business activities; nominee shareholders and nominee legal representative used to conceal the true ownership structure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disregard or recharacterization under GAAR (EIT Law Article 47); denial of treaty benefits and the 5% dividend rate; deemed-dividend adjustment of the diverted profits; penalty of 50%–500% of short-paid tax plus 5% special-tax-adjustment interest per annum for up to 10 years; possible revocation of the WFOE's business license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors and actual controllers are jointly and severally liable for unpaid corporate tax; they may be subject to personal asset freezing, exit bans, and criminal liability for fraudulent registration and evasion-related offenses.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fraudulent Special VAT Invoices (虚开增值税专用发票)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Issuing or obtaining false special VAT invoices for robotic component purchases, inflating input credits, or illegally obtaining export tax refunds on AI pet robot outbound shipments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal Law Articles 204–205: fines and imprisonment up to life sentence for fraudulent issuance of special VAT invoices; confiscation of property for particularly serious cases; administrative revocation of VAT invoice quota and export refund eligibility.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: In a unit crime, the legal representative, financial executives, and procurement officers who executed the scheme are criminally liable even if the company is fined; courts issue asset freezes and travel bans during investigation; civil compensation is available to the customs and tax authorities within the statutory framework.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Systematic below-cost sales of assembled robots to the Taiwan parent; disproportionate profit allocation leaving the WFOE at a persistent loss; unjustified royalty payments to a Taiwan IP shell; failure to file related-party tables or Local File.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Transfer-pricing adjustment to arm's-length result with 5% per annum special tax adjustment interest on the underpaid tax; penalty of 50% of the underpaid tax (Tax Collection Administration Law Article 63); dual-filing non-compliance penalty of RMB 2,000–10,000 for the annual CIT return and up to RMB 100,000 for refusal to provide contemporaneous documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and general manager who approved the pricing policy are exposed to being named in the tax adjustment notice; personal liability attaches if the transfer pricing scheme was used to evade tax and the director knowingly caused the WFOE to default, triggering joint and several liability for the tax debt and potential criminal complicity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to Withhold Dividend WHT and Thin Capitalization
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing profits to the Taiwan shareholder without withholding 10% (or the agreed 5%) dividend tax; disguising equity distributions as interest payments or service fees from shareholder loans that breach the 2:1 debt-to-equity ratio.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The WFOE as withholding agent is jointly and severally liable for the un-withheld tax under Tax Collection Administration Law Article 69, with penalties of 50%–300% of the un-collected tax; excess interest is disallowed as a deduction and recharacterized as a deemed dividend subject to WHT; late-payment surcharge accrues from the distribution date.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorized the unlawful distribution may be personally ordered to repay the distributed funds to the company for satisfaction of tax debts; the legal representative is subject to exit restriction until the tax is settled; civil fraud liability against the board exists where the distribution was made with knowledge of unpaid taxes.
